definition: Season year extracted from the local pitch date.
use_as_model_feature: Yes, for season normalization or splits only
notes: Derived from Trackman Date. Useful for train/test splits and season-level calibration.

definition: Unique pitch identifier for the pitch event.
notes: Use only to return predictions and join results back internally. Do not use as a model input.

definition: Anonymous game identifier created by Diablos for the hackathon dataset.
notes: Use for grouping, validation splits, or aggregation only. Do not use as a direct model feature.

definition: Anonymous pitcher identifier created by Diablos for the hackathon dataset.
notes: Use for aggregation and returning pitcher-level results only. Avoid using as a direct feature to prevent player memorization.

definition: Anonymous batter identifier created by Diablos for the hackathon dataset.
notes: Use for aggregation or handedness checks only. Avoid as a direct Stuff+ feature.

definition: Anonymous catcher identifier created by Diablos for the hackathon dataset.
notes: Use for grouping or diagnostics only. Avoid as a direct Stuff+ feature.

definition: Throwing hand of the pitcher for the pitch.
